snippet.title: VMX - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Today is the day! VMX finally has released on Steam for PCVR. Will you Bike or Scoot? Are you going to customize your paint job? How long will it take you to master all the tricks? Can you handle playing online? Are you going to choose to use our motion modes to reduce motion sickness? What game mode will be your favorite? So many questions for you to answer once you hop into VMX.

Purchase it now at https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554630/VMX/

VMX is a VR BMX MTB Scooter and extreme sports game with gestural movement, detailed vehicular customization, and multiplayer game modes to play with your friends! The game will release on Quest 2, Quest 3, and PC VR headsets.  We are a small indie team trying to create something extreme in the world of VR. We have developed the game in unreal engine 5.

Check out all our socials at vmxgame.com/links
